replies.author: hpux
replies.body: Most Nebula maps have void, so we thought we could change it up a bit and try to see if the gameplay here works well too. We did a test run on it and the gameplay was almost equivalent to the Nebula maps with void. Personally I think it's better to have a few maps to change it up. It's still possible to get knocked off though.

replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Very interesting map and nice design. The obstacles will make the gameplay a little bit more interesting.

Some suggestions:

Make the main floor of the map less flat.

Looking from that picture the stone/brick floor is very flat. You should add some height variation even if its only a block or two. 

Another thing that could be worked on is the ship. You should add planks to it not only logs. Possibly stairs, ladders just to make it look a little nicer. The sails are also very very "weird" and you would not see them shape that way in real life.
